PUBLICATION OF SASOL’S ANNUAL REPORTS FOR THE FINANCIAL YEAR ENDED
30 JUNE 2026


The following reports covering Sasol’s financial year ended 30 June 2026 have been published on
Sasol’s website:


1. Integrated and Sustainability Report and performance data tables
2. Annual financial statements
3. Tax Report
4. Annual report on Form 20-F


Sasol's annual report on Form 20-F, which includes the annual financial statements for the year ended
30 June 2026, will be filed with the United States (US) Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The
Form 20-F contains no changes to the annual financial statements published and will be available on the
SEC’s website at[https://www.sec.gov/](https://www.sec.gov/) .


Copies of all the aforementioned reports can be obtained by downloading copies from the Company’s
website,[https://www.sasol.com/investor-centre](https://www.sasol.com/investor-centre) or by requesting copies from Sasol Investor Relations by
means of either:


- an e-mail toinvestor.relations@sasol.com ; or
- written correspondence posted to Private Bag X10014, Sandton, 2196, South Africa.


Note to holders of Domestic Medium-Term Notes


Sasol’s report on the application of the King V Report on Corporate Governance for South Africa, 2025
(King V) incorporated by reference in the Domestic Medium-Term Note programme, have accordingly
been replaced and are available at:[https://www.sasol.com/who-we-are/corporate-governance](https://www.sasol.com/who-we-are/corporate-governance) . The
King V application report will also be made available for inspection, at the election of the person
requesting inspection, through a secure electronic connection.


1 September 2026
Johannesburg
